tweetHighlights.originalBody:
At @vercel we got to test this model before release. Best way to summarize it: astonishingly brilliant.

One interesting takeaway: it's very clear that this new generation of models can take on unprecedented bodies of parallel work.

To actually seize this intelligence, you need cloud sandboxes. Full stop. The model can delegate and orchestrate far more than a single computer can handle. Likely far more than you can even imagine it can handle.

Your bottleneck is now ① your ambition and ② your parallel computing power.

Btw, I learned from @cramforce you don't need to overcomplicate it. Install Vercel CLI, setup the Plugin and tell the agent to use /𝚘𝚏𝚏𝚕𝚘𝚊𝚍-𝚝𝚘-𝚜𝚊𝚗𝚍𝚋𝚘𝚡 skill. It'll provision and de-allocate cloud sandboxes as needed. You don't need a "multi-agent remote harness ralph orchestrator" 😆
tweetHighlights.translatedTitle: 在 @vercel，我们有机会在发布前测试这个模型。
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
在 @vercel，我们有机会在正式发布前测试了这个模型。简单来说：简直惊艳绝伦。

一个重要的发现是：很明显，新一代模型能够处理前所未有的并行工作量。

要真正发挥这种智能，你需要云沙箱。毋庸置疑。该模型可以委派和协调的任务远远超过单台计算机的处理能力。甚至可能远远超出你的想象。

现在，你的瓶颈在于：①你的雄心壮志；②你的并行计算能力。

顺便一提，我从 @cramforce 学到，你不需要把它搞得太复杂。安装 Vercel CLI，设置插件，然后告诉代理使用 /𝚘𝚏𝚏𝚕𝚘𝚊𝚍-𝚝𝚘-𝚜𝚊𝚗𝚍𝚋𝚘𝚡 技能即可。它会根据需要配置和释放云沙箱。你不需要“多代理远程 Ralph 编排器”😆

tweetHighlights.originalBody:
So bullish on MCP. Its utility exceeds the "M" part: even AI aside, it'll be a civilization-scale accomplishment to get all our systems communicating through one universal open protocol.

A missing piece was how to get arbitrary callbacks across sessions. MCP could read and write, but it couldn't tell you later "this event happened." MCP Events fixes this.

We're adding support in our own MCP. Say an agent makes a deployment, and wants to know when it's complete. Instead of polling, it can subscribe to 𝚍𝚎𝚙𝚕𝚘𝚢𝚖𝚎𝚗𝚝.𝚜𝚞𝚌𝚌𝚎𝚎𝚍𝚎𝚍.

PSA: With Vercel Queues and Workflows, writing the backend machinery for your own MCPs to do this is easy peasy.
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
我对 MCP 非常看好。它的实用性远超“M”字头：即使抛开人工智能不谈，让所有系统通过一个通用的开放协议进行通信也将是一项文明级别的成就。

之前缺失的一环是如何跨会话获取任意回调。MCP 可以读写，但无法事后告知“此事件已发生”。MCP Events 解决了这个问题。

我们正在自己的 MCP 中添加对 MCP Events 的支持。假设一个代理执行了一次部署，并想知道部署何时完成。它可以订阅 𝚍𝚎𝚙𝚕𝚘𝚢𝚖𝚎𝚗𝚝.𝚜𝚞𝚌𝚌𝚎𝚎𝚍𝚎𝚍，而不是轮询。

友情提示：借助 Vercel 队列和工作流，为自己的 MCP 编写后端机制来实现此功能轻而易举。

tweetHighlights.originalTitle: It turns out the advancements we’re getting in coding and computer use, combined wi…
tweetHighlights.originalBody:
It turns out the advancements we’re getting in coding and computer use, combined with industry specific understand and general reasoning, can bring automation to a large number of areas of knowledge work.

We’re entering the era of autonomous collaborators in a number of industries that haven’t yet had their claude code or codex moment yet. But now this is going to happen. 

We’ll see it in animation, film production, gaming, manufacturing, architecture, product design, robotics, and more. All of these fields have the potential of driving far more output similar to what we’ve seen in software engineering. There’s no inherent finite demand for these categories of work.

“Software is eating the world” is finally in a much bigger way happening because of AI.
tweetHighlights.translatedTitle: 事实证明，我们在编程和计算机使用方面取得的进步，再加上……
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
事实证明，我们在编码和计算机应用方面取得的进步，结合行业特定的理解和通用推理能力，能够将自动化引入众多知识型工作领域。

我们正在进入一个由自主协作者主导的时代，许多行业此前尚未经历类似“克劳德代码”或“法典时刻”的变革。但现在，这一切即将发生。

我们将在动画、电影制作、游戏、制造业、建筑、产品设计、机器人等领域看到它的身影。所有这些领域都有潜力创造远超软件工程领域的产出。这些工作类别本身并不存在有限的需求。

“软件正在吞噬世界”的论调，如今正因人工智能而以前所未有的规模成为现实。
